name: Bloodthirsty Strike
description: You unleash a savage blow fueled by your thirst for blood, dealing more damage when you or your allies are wounded.
effect: When you or an ally within 15 feet has taken damage, you can add +2 damage to your next melee attack.
special: Once per round.

name: Dark Vision
description: Your eyes have adapted to the darkness, allowing you to see what others cannot.
effect: You gain the ability to see in complete darkness as if it were dim light, up to 60 feet.
special: Your vision is slightly blurred in daylight, giving you disadvantage on Perception checks under bright light.

name: Quickdraw
description: You can react swiftly and draw your weapon faster than your opponents.
effect: You can draw or switch weapons as a free action, and you gain +1d6 to initiative rolls.

name: Vengeful Fury
description: Your anger grows with each wound. The more hurt you are, the more deadly your strikes become.
effect: For every wound do you have, you gain +1 to your melee damage.

name: Fearless Charge
description: You rush into combat without hesitation, inspiring fear in your enemies as you close the gap.
effect: When charging an opponent, you gain advantage on your first melee attack. In addition, enemies within 10 feet of you must pass a Willpower check or be frightened until the end of their next turn.
special: Once per encounter.

name: Eldritch Knowledge
description: You have dabbled in forbidden lore, gaining insight into dark magic and ancient secrets.
effect: Gain +2d6 to Arcane Knowledge checks. Additionally, once per day, you can.
special: If you succeed in deciphering, you may unlock temporary bonuses (GM's discretion), but if you fail, you may suffer a minor curse or side effect.

name: Unyielding Defense
description: You are a wall in combat, able to take hits that would fell lesser warriors.
effect: Once per encounter, you can reduce incoming damage by half.
special: When used, this ability also grants you resistance to knockback or push effects until the start of your next turn.

name: Keen Senses
description: Your senses are razor-sharp, allowing you to detect hidden threats and subtle cues in the environment.
effect: You gain +1d6 to Insight checks. Additionally, you gain advantage on rolls to detect hidden creatures or traps.
special: This ability can be used in both urban and wilderness environments.

name: Shadow Cloak
description: You can blend into the shadows with ease, becoming nearly invisible when you're not moving.
effect: Gain advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness. While motionless, you are effectively invisible to enemies without supernatural sight.
special: This effect ends when you move or take any other action.

name: War Cry
description: Your voice can rally allies or strike fear into the hearts of enemies.
effect: Once per encounter, you can let out a war cry. Allies within 30 feet gain +1d6 to attack rolls until the end of your next turn. Enemies within the same range must pass a Willpower check or suffer disadvantage on their next attack.
special: Can only be used once per long rest.

name: Paso Rápido
description: Mediante movimientos veloces y precisos, puedes esquivar ataques con mayor facilidad.
effect: Aumenta tu defensa contra ataques físicos en +2 y te permite realizar un movimiento adicional de 2 metros como reacción una vez por turno.
special: Si esquivas completamente un ataque, puedes contraatacar inmediatamente con un +1 a tu tirada.

name: Eco de Sangre
description: Has aprendido a absorber la esencia vital de tus enemigos derrotados.
effect: Cuando derrotas a un enemigo, recuperas 1d4 puntos de vida. Los enemigos más poderosos pueden otorgar hasta 2d4 puntos.
special: Si el golpe final fue crítico, duplica la cantidad de puntos recuperados.

name: Rugido Bestial
description: Canalizas tu naturaleza bestial para emitir un rugido sobrenatural que desorienta a tus enemigos.
effect: Los enemigos en un radio de 5 metros deben superar una tirada de Voluntad (Dificultad 14) o quedarán aturdidos durante 1 turno.
special: Las criaturas bestiales tienen desventaja en esta tirada de salvación.

name: Perspicacia del Cazador
description: Tus experiencias en la cacería te han otorgado una comprensión única de las debilidades de tus presas.
effect: Después de observar a un enemigo durante un turno completo, puedes identificar sus vulnerabilidades, ganando +2 a las tiradas de ataque y daño contra ese enemigo.
special: Si identificas correctamente la debilidad elemental del enemigo, aplicas daño adicional 1d6 del tipo correspondiente.

name: Ataque Visceral
description: Has dominado el arte de explotar las aperturas en la defensa de tus enemigos para asestar golpes devastadores.
effect: Después de aturdir o desequilibrar a un enemigo, puedes realizar un ataque visceral que inflige el doble de daño base.
special: Contra enemigos humanoides, tienes la oportunidad de recuperar 1d4 balas de mercurio con un ataque exitoso.

name: Hueso del Viejo Cazador
description: Posees un fragmento óseo de un cazador antiguo que te permite deslizarte a través del espacio mediante magia arcana.
effect: Puedes teletransportarte hasta 10 metros como acción principal una vez por combate. No provocas ataques de oportunidad al usar esta habilidad.
special: Si te teletransportas detrás de un enemigo, tu próximo ataque tiene ventaja.

name: Swift Healer
description: Your body recovers from wounds faster than most, allowing you to bounce back in combat.
effect: When you roll hit dice to recover health during a short rest, you gain an additional 1d6 hit points.
special: Once per day, you may automatically stabilize when reduced to 0 hit points.

name: Poisoner
description: You are skilled in creating and applying poisons to your weapons or drinks, making you a deadly opponent.
effect: Gain +2 to Alchemy checks related to poison creation. Once per day, you can coat your weapon with a deadly poison that deals an extra 1d4 damage for 3 rounds.

name: Ambush Specialist
description: You are an expert at attacking from cover, taking your enemies by surprise before they have time to react.
effect: When attacking from stealth or cover, you gain +2 to attack rolls and deal an additional 1d6 damage if the attack hits.
special: Once per long rest, you can initiate combat from stealth with advantage on initiative.

name: Second Wind
description: You can push past your limits and regain a surge of energy in the heat of battle.
effect: Once per encounter, you may regain 1d6 hit points as a bonus action.
special: You also gain +1 to your next attack roll after using this ability.

name: Steely Resolve
description: Your mind is fortified against external influence, making it difficult for others to manipulate or control you.
effect: Gain advantage on Willpower checks to resist fear, charm, or mind control effects.

name: Alchemist's Insight
description: Your deep knowledge of alchemy allows you to make potions and brews faster than others.
effect: You can brew potions in half the normal time, and you can use potions as a bonus action instead of a full action in combat.
special: You can identify the properties of unknown substances or potions with a successful Alchemy check.

name: Evasive Maneuver
description: You are adept at avoiding danger, even in the thick of battle.
effect: Once per encounter, you can take half damage from an area-of-effect attack or trap. Additionally, when dodging, you gain +1 to your next Dodge roll.

name: Hunter's Reflexes
description: You have honed your reflexes to near-superhuman levels, able to react to danger in an instant.
effect: Once per encounter, when an enemy attacks you, you can dodge as a reaction, negating the attack entirely if you succeed on a Dexterity check.

name: Eldritch Insight
description: Exposure to forbidden knowledge has sharpened your understanding of the unnatural world.
effect: Gain advantage on rolls to identify eldritch creatures and aberrations. Once per day, you can decipher cryptic runes or strange symbols.
special: Extended exposure to eldritch knowledge risks mental instability.

name: Blood Rites
description: You've mastered the art of drawing power from blood, whether it be your own or your enemies'.
effect: When you deal damage to an enemy, you can choose to sacrifice 1d4 health to deal an additional 1d6 damage. You may use this ability once per encounter.
special: If you reduce yourself to below half health using this ability, you gain +1 to all attack rolls until the end of the encounter.

name: Shadow Step
description: You can move through the shadows, becoming almost invisible in low light.
effect: In dim light or darkness, you can teleport up to 15 feet as a bonus action, provided you can see your destination. After using this ability, you must wait until the start of your next turn before using it again.

name: Frenzied Assault
description: Driven by bloodlust, your attacks become wilder and more lethal as you become injured.
effect: For every 10% of your health that you lose, you gain +1 to your attack rolls (up to +4). However, all enemies gain advantage on attack rolls against you while you are frenzied.

name: Beast's Strength
description: The dark power within you grants unnatural physical strength in moments of need.
effect: Once per encounter, you can add +2 to your Strength for a single melee attack or skill check involving raw physical power.
special: After using this ability, you suffer a level of fatigue.

name: Scent of Blood
description: You can sense the presence of bleeding or wounded creatures nearby.
effect: Once per encounter, you can detect the exact location of any creature within 60 feet that is bleeding or below half its health, even if they are hidden or invisible.

name: Rallying Cry
description: Your defiant shout emboldens your allies, giving them the strength to press forward.
effect: Once per day, you can let out a rallying cry. All allies within 30 feet regain 1d4 hit points and gain +1 to their next attack roll.
special: Can only be used after an ally has fallen to 0 hit points or is gravely wounded.

name: Blood Transfusion
description: You can channel your own blood to heal wounds, both yours and others'.
effect: Once per encounter, you can sacrifice 1d6 hit points to heal an ally within 30 feet for the same amount. Alternatively, you can heal yourself by the same amount.
special: Using this ability too often may lead to temporary weakness (-1 to Constitution until a long rest).

name: Hunter's Precision
description: Your experience in hunting has granted you unparalleled precision when aiming for vital spots.
effect: Once per encounter, you can declare a critical hit on an attack roll that would normally hit (without needing to roll for a natural 20).

name: Fearsome Reputation
description: Tales of your feats have spread, and your mere presence instills fear in those who oppose you.
effect: Once per encounter, you can force an enemy to make a Willpower check or be frightened of you for 1d4 turns.
special: Those who resist this ability will become more determined to defeat you, gaining advantage on their next attack against you.

name: Blood Hunter's Rage
description: You can enter a state of furious rage, driven by your connection to blood and violence.
effect: Once per encounter, you enter a rage that lasts 1d6 turns. While raging, you gain +2 to Strength and Constitution but suffer -1 to all defense rolls. At the end of the rage, you suffer 1d6 damage as backlash.

name: Dark Whispers
description: Exposure to eldritch forces has granted you the ability to hear the thoughts or intentions of nearby creatures.
effect: Once per day, you can make a Willpower check to read the surface thoughts of a creature within 30 feet. If the target is eldritch in nature, you gain advantage on the check.
special: Prolonged use may lead to madness or hallucinations.

name: Swift Retribution
description: When you are struck by an enemy, your reflexes allow you to strike back swiftly.
effect: Once per encounter, when an enemy successfully hits you with a melee attack, you can make a melee attack in response without expending your action.

name: Cloak of Shadows
description: The shadows themselves seem to cling to you, making you harder to detect.
effect: Gain advantage on Stealth checks when moving through areas of low light. While standing still in shadows, you are invisible to mundane creatures.
special: Eldritch creatures or those with supernatural senses may still be able to detect you.

name: Bloodhound
description: You have trained your senses to detect the scent of blood and prey, making you an expert tracker.
effect: Gain advantage on Tracking rolls and Perception checks to follow blood trails or detect wounded prey.

name: Eldritch Shield
description: You have learned to channel eldritch energy to form a temporary shield, protecting you from harm.
effect: Once per encounter, you can activate a shield of dark energy that absorbs the next 10 points of damage you would take. The shield lasts for 1d6 turns or until broken.
special: Activating the shield reduces your Willpower by 1 for the rest of the encounter.

name: Ritual of Blood
description: You have learned a dark ritual that draws power from spilled blood to grant you strength.
effect: Once per day, after a creature is killed within 30 feet of you, you can perform the Ritual of Blood, gaining 1d6 hit points and +1 to your next attack roll.
special: If you fail to perform this ritual correctly (by rolling a natural 1), you instead suffer 1d4 psychic damage.
